activity.notes: Henry the Fowler was elected king in 919 and ruled until his death in 936. ATLAS attaches the representative reign to the existing East Francia polity, reflecting the East Frankish/German kingship from which the later Ottonian imperial monarchy developed.

sources.title: Henry I — king of Germany — Encyclopaedia Britannica
sources.citation_text: Britannica states that Henry was elected German king in May 919 and ruled until his death on 2 July 936.

sources.title: 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica — Henry I. 'the Fowler'
sources.citation_text: The historical reference records Henry's election in May 919, recognition as king of the East Franks, and death in July 936.
